notes: AMENDMENTS-015 B78 curated gatherable base-material registry (P4-prep slice). Each entry is a material the world itself yields with starting tools — blocks and woods generated in every world, herbs, gems, natural pickups, and materials the pre-Hardmode enemies of their biome drop — quoted verbatim from its article (checked against the cached revision). It adds one gate-free, early pre-Hardmode §7b route to the item (merge/gating.ts 'gather'), unless the entry names conditions: a world-evil material carries corruption-world / crimson-world, a Dungeon material post-skeletron (the Dungeon needs Skeletron first), Pearlwood hardmode, Fallen Star night (it falls at night). `requiresAnyOf`: the material only drops while one of the listed items is held (minimum over their gating).
Hand-crafted chains whose every ingredient (and station) is gatherable therefore derive as early pre-Hardmode with no boss gate — 'all-gatherable ingredients → early-prehm' (B78).

Deliberately NOT listed (their routes stay Unknown, reasons in the gap report): the pre-Hardmode ores — a world generates only one ore of each tier ('A world will generally only contain one ore type from each tier', Ores) and the other comes from slime bonus drops / crates / the Extractinator, routes the data cannot derive, so no gate-free or condition-exact route exists (their bars derive through chest loot where the Drops data lists it); Demonite / Crimtane / Meteorite / Hellstone / Obsidian / Ebonstone / Crimstone (pickaxe-power or event requirements); Rotten Chunk / Vertebra (their articles do not state the world evil); Pumpkin (seasonal); Pearlsand (its article does not state Hardmode).

entries.quote: Wood is a type of block that is generally obtained by cutting down trees using an axe or a chainsaw
entries.why: Trees grow on the surface of every world; the starting Copper Axe chops them.

entries.quote: Boreal Wood is a type of wood harvested from Boreal trees found naturally growing in the Snow biome
entries.why: Natural trees of the Snow biome.

entries.quote: Rich Mahogany is a type of wood harvested from Mahogany trees found naturally growing in the Jungle and Underground Jungle
Palm Wood is a type of wood harvested from Palm trees found naturally growing in the Ocean biome and Oasis biome.
Ebonwood is a type of wood harvested from Ebonwood trees and Ebonwood Palm trees found naturally growing in Corruption biomes.
entries.why: Natural trees of the Corruption (Corruption worlds).

entries.quote: Shadewood is a type of wood harvested from Shadewood trees and Shadewood Palm trees found naturally growing in Crimson biomes.
entries.why: Natural trees of the Crimson (Crimson worlds).

entries.quote: Ash Wood is a type of wood harvested from Ash trees found naturally growing in Ash forests.
entries.why: Natural trees of the Underworld's Ash forests; reaching the Underworld needs no boss.

entries.quote: Pearlwood is a Hardmode-exclusive[a] type of wood harvested from Pearlwood trees and Pearlwood Palm trees found naturally growing in Hallow biomes.
entries.why: The Hallow trees only exist in Hardmode.

entries.quote: The Stone Block is a type of block that is generated naturally in very large parts of the world.
entries.why: Generated in the Underground and Cavern layers of every world; any pickaxe mines it.

entries.quote: The Dirt Block is one of the most common blocks in Terraria, occurring naturally almost everywhere throughout the world.
Mud Blocks are a very common block type that comprises the majority of the Jungle, Underground Jungle, and Glowing Mushroom biome.
It is found primarily in Surface-level (above 0 elevation) areas, and is more rare at the upper parts of the Underground.
Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes, at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes
Ebonsand, Crimsand, and Pearlsand are biome variants of Sand Blocks, corresponding to the Corruption, Crimson, and Hallow, respectively
Ebonsand, Crimsand, and Pearlsand are biome variants of Sand Blocks, corresponding to the Corruption, Crimson, and Hallow, respectively
The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block, along with Sandstone Blocks, that make up the Underground Desert biome.
Sandstone Blocks are blocks found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome.
Snow Blocks are blocks found naturally-placed in the Snow biome.
Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes.
Slush Blocks are blocks that appear naturally in Ice biomes.
Silt Blocks are a type of soil blocks that generates in the Underground and Cavern layers, appearing more frequently at lower depths.
The Ash Block is a block that covers the upper and lower sections of The Underworld
entries.why: Every world's Underworld; reaching it needs no boss.

entries.quote: The Marble Block is a natural block found in Marble Caves.
Granite is a block found underground in Granite Caves.
Amethyst is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
Topaz is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
Sapphire is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
Emerald is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
Ruby is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
Diamond is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
Amber is a gem found within the Underground Desert of a world.

support.quote: It grows naturally on regular grass and Hallowed grass. Daybloom can be harvested with virtually any weapon or tool

entries.why: Wild herb, harvested with any tool.

entries.quote: Moonglow is a type of herb which appears as a bent stalk with a drooping blue-white flower.

support.quote: It grows naturally on regular Jungle grass. Moonglow can be harvested with virtually any weapon or tool

entries.why: Wild herb, harvested with any tool.

entries.quote: Blinkroot is a type of herb that appears as stems with glowing dots.

support.quote: Blinkroot can be harvested with virtually any weapon or tool

entries.why: Wild herb, harvested with any tool.

entries.quote: Waterleaf is a type of herb which appears as a small, turquoise-colored sprout.

support.quote: Waterleaf can be harvested with virtually any weapon or tool

entries.why: Wild herb, harvested with any tool.

entries.quote: It grows naturally on Ebonstone, Crimstone, Corrupt grass, Crimson grass, Corrupt Jungle grass, and Crimson Jungle grass.
entries.why: Wild herb of both evil biomes, so of every world.

entries.quote: Shiverthorn is a type of herb which appears as an icy-blue flower.

support.quote: Shiverthorn can be harvested with virtually any weapon or tool

entries.why: Wild herb, harvested with any tool.

entries.quote: Fireblossom is a type of herb which appears as a small, magma-colored flower.

support.quote: Fireblossom can be harvested with virtually any weapon or tool

entries.why: Wild herb of the Underworld's Ash; reaching it needs no boss.

entries.quote: The Mushroom is a pre-Hardmode crafting material and recovery potion that spawns randomly on grass or Hallowed grass on the surface layer.
entries.why: Wild surface plant, harvested with any tool.

entries.quote: The Glowing Mushroom is a plant, crafting material, and block that can be found on Mushroom grass in the Glowing Mushroom biome.
entries.why: Wild plant of the Glowing Mushroom biome.

entries.quote: The Vile Mushroom is a type of mushroom growing on Corrupt grass or Corrupt Jungle grass, where they can be cut and collected with a single swing from any weapon or tool.
entries.why: Wild plant of the Corruption (Corruption worlds).

entries.quote: The Vicious Mushroom is a type of mushroom growing on Crimson grass or Crimson Jungle grass, where they can be cut and collected with a single swing of any weapon or tool.
entries.why: Wild plant of the Crimson (Crimson worlds).

entries.quote: Jungle Spores are crafting materials acquired by destroying green glowing orbs that grow randomly on Jungle grass in the Underground Jungle, in or below the Cavern layer.
Cactus is a crafting material obtained by harvesting Cactus plants, using an axe or chainsaw just like with trees.

support.quote: The cactus plant grows in Desert biomes on all types of Sand

entries.quote: Cobwebs are commonly found in underground areas in clusters of 5 or more alongside the edges of walls or ceilings, and are guaranteed to drop a Cobweb item when broken
Corals are crafting materials which can be found in the Ocean biomes at the ends of the world.
Life Crystals can be found naturally placed in any area in the Underground layer and below, though they are fairly uncommon.
The Fallen Star is an item that randomly falls from the sky at night and disappears at dawn (4:30 AM).
entries.why: Falls every night; collecting it needs night (a time condition chip, never a gate).

entries.quote: Acorns are randomly dropped when cutting down or shaking trees and can also be purchased from the Dryad for 10 Copper each.
While a Blowpipe or Blowgun is in a player's inventory, there is a chance that any vegetation growing on normal grass, in Clay Pots, and in Planter Boxes will drop Seeds.
entries.why: Grass vegetation drops Seeds only while a Blowpipe or Blowgun is held — the minimum over those two weapons' gating.

entries.quote: Gel is a common crafting material dropped by most slimes and Slimed Zombies

support.quote: Gel is vital due to it being an ingredient in Torches, and is used regularly from the beginning stages all the way through to endgame scenarios

entries.why: Slimes are the first enemies of every world; the article places Gel in use from the beginning stages.

entries.quote: A Lens is a common crafting material that has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance to drop from Demon Eyes and Wandering Eyes.
entries.why: Demon Eyes are common pre-Hardmode enemies; no boss is involved.

entries.quote: The Black Lens is a crafting material dropped by Demon Eyes and Wandering Eyes at a 1/100 (1%) chance.
The Feather is a common crafting material dropped frequently by Harpies.
entries.why: Harpies are pre-Hardmode enemies of the Space layer.

entries.quote: It is obtained from Spiked Jungle Slimes, Hornets, and Moss Hornets found in the Underground Jungle biome.
entries.why: Hornets and Spiked Jungle Slimes are pre-Hardmode Underground Jungle enemies.

entries.quote: Vines are crafting materials dropped by Man Eaters in the Underground Jungle biome with a 1/2 (50%) / 100% drop chance.
entries.why: Man Eaters are pre-Hardmode Underground Jungle enemies.

entries.quote: The Shark Fin is a crafting material that has a 19/20 (95%) chance of being dropped by Sharks and Orcas found in the Ocean biome
Flinx Fur is a crafting material dropped by Snow Flinx, an enemy found in the Ice biome.
entries.why: Snow Flinx are pre-Hardmode Ice biome enemies.

entries.quote: The Antlion Mandible is a crafting material dropped by Antlions, Antlion Larvae, Antlion Chargers, and Antlion Swarmers found in the Desert and Underground Desert biomes.
Pink Gel is a rare crafting material dropped by Pinky in stacks of 25–50.
entries.why: Pinky is a rare pre-Hardmode surface slime.

entries.quote: The Tattered Cloth is a crafting material that is always dropped by Goblin Scouts.
entries.why: Goblin Scouts appear at the world's surface edges without any boss.

entries.quote: It has a 1/25 (4%) chance to drop from Skeletons, Undead Miners, Hoplites, and Undead Vikings in the Marble Caves, Ice biome, and Cavern layer.
Worm Tooth is a crafting material dropped by Devourers in The Corruption.
entries.why: Devourers live in the Corruption (Corruption worlds).
